summary: Adapter prepares TDD slices only after strict skill-input gate; backend hidden state must be false and shell commands are forbidden; declared slice and current contract/validator hashes required; lifecycle is prepared→red-observed→green-observed→refactor-verified, enforcing failure/pass exit codes and allowed path sets; RED permits tests/docs only, GREEN production only, REFACTOR production/tests/docs; unknown or invalid transitions block; candidate finalization is non-authoritative and requires exactly red,green,refactor; resume rejects stale identities and failed/stale/superseded runs; stage binding validates capsule/attempt consistency and returns hashes; protocol persistence validates schema, artifact identities, containment, no reparse points, immutable conflicts, and ordered decision writes; execute rejects existing run directories, requires bundle/store pairing, persists recovery-state.v1 with no authorizations; acceptance, handoff, and release remain unauthorized.
